title: StaRPO: Stability-Augmented Reinforcement Policy Optimization
abstract: arXiv:2604.08905v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Reinforcement learning (RL) is effective in enhancing the accuracy of large language models in complex reasoning tasks. Existing RL policy optimization frameworks rely on final-answer correctness as feedback signals and rarely capture the internal logical structure of the reasoning process. Consequently, the models would generate fluent and semantically relevant responses but logically inconsistent, structurally erratic, or redundant. To this end, we propose StaRPO, a stability-augmented reinforcement learning framework that explicitly incorporates reasoning stability into the optimization objective. translated_title: StaRPO：稳定性增强的强化策略优化
translated_abstract: 强化学习（RL）在提升大型语言模型于复杂推理任务中的准确性方面非常有效。然而，现有的RL策略优化框架依赖最终答案的正确性作为反馈信号，很少捕捉推理过程的内部逻辑结构。因此，模型会生成流畅且语义相关的回答，但往往存在逻辑不一致、结构混乱或冗余的问题。为此，我们提出了StaRPO，这是一种稳定性增强的强化学习框架，将推理稳定性显式地纳入优化目标。StaRPO将稳定性分解为两个可计算的轻量级指标：自相关函数（ACF）用于评估局部的逐步连贯性，路径效率（PE）用于评估推理轨迹的全局目标导向性。这些稳定性奖励与任务奖励相结合，提供互补的、过程性的信号。
tldr: 提出StaRPO框架，通过自相关函数（ACF）和路径效率（PE）两个轻量级指标将推理稳定性显式纳入强化学习优化目标，从而改善大语言模型推理过程的逻辑一致性与结构稳定性。
en_tdlr: StaRPO is a stability-augmented RL framework that explicitly incorporates reasoning stability—measured by the Autocorrelation Function (ACF) for local coherence and Path Efficiency (PE) for global goal-directedness—into the policy optimization objective, improving the logical consistency of LLM reasoning beyond final-answer correctness.
